name: Refactor Chat.vue - Use Collapsible for file list and profiles

messages.content:
## Issue
Chat.vue needs to use Collapsible component for better UI organization:
- File list should be collapsible (truncated in header, expandable in detail)
- Profiles section should use collapsible component
- List should appear in header when collapsed

## Requirements
- Replace static file list with Collapsible component
- Implement header truncation when collapsed
- Show preview/summary in header
- Expand to full list on detail view
- Apply same pattern to profiles section
- Maintain all existing functionality

## Acceptance Criteria
✓ File list uses Collapsible component
✓ Profiles section uses Collapsible component
✓ Header shows truncated list/summary when collapsed
✓ Full list visible when expanded
✓ No data loss or functionality regression
✓ Responsive on mobile and desktop
